minutes.headline: Select Board appointed a new Treasurer-Collector and ratified an executive assistant; FY16 budget shows a gap.
minutes.summary: The board heard the Lunenburg Snow Riders present a recreational trails grant request for the Lane property. Members gave committee reports and a recap of the Mark transportation workshop. The town manager reported on the FY16 budget outlook, and the board made two appointments before going into executive session.

public_comment.topic: Presented the club's history and its 2015 recreational trails grant application for the Lane property.

votes.motion: Ratify the appointment of Elaine Peterson as executive assistant effective February 17th.
Rescind the temporary Treasurer-Collector appointment and appoint Mylene malari as Treasurer-Collector.
Go into executive session for non-union contract negotiations, not returning to open session.

budget_items.what_was_said: The club described an earlier recreational trails grant and its match, used for a trail maintenance vehicle.
The club described its 2015 request for the Lane property and the match it would supply.
figures_as_heard: thirty four thousand seven hundred ninety nine dollars and two cents

budget_items.what_was_said: The board wants expanded service within the existing MBTA assessment, and a member will work with Mark on routes.
The library asked the finance committee for a reserve fund transfer for higher utility costs; no transfer was made yet.
The school committee was told an MSBA installment came in for the middle high school project.
The school committee raised the substitute nurse daily rate.
The town manager said the snow and ice budget has been exceeded and FEMA reimbursement may be possible.
The town manager reported a deficit against target budgets, driven by retirement and health insurance increases.

decisions.decision: A member will set up a time with Mark to work out routes and will keep spending at or under the existing MBTA assessment.
A member will put the septic and sewer loan program article on the town meeting warrant and contact the Board of Health.

what_happened.line: The Select Board voted to rescind the temporary Treasurer-Collector appointment and appoint a permanent Treasurer-Collector.
The board voted to ratify the appointment of an executive assistant, effective February 17th.
The town manager reported a deficit against target budgets for FY16, driven by retirement and health insurance increases.
The town manager said the snow and ice budget has been exceeded and FEMA reimbursement may be possible.
The Snow Riders presented a recreational trails grant request for the Lane property, and the board agreed to seek expanded transportation service within the existing MBTA assessment.

why_it_matters: Rising retirement and health insurance costs are pushing the FY16 town budget over its targets, which bears on what services the town can fund and on the tax bill.
Snow and ice spending past its budget will have to be covered somewhere in the town budget, mostly taxes, unless FEMA reimbursement comes through.
watch_next: A septic and sewer loan program article is to be put on the town meeting warrant, with the Board of Health to be contacted.
The library's reserve fund transfer request for higher utility costs, which the finance committee had not acted on yet.
